clue.text: Capital victory followed by a little drink, say

parts.note: a victory is a win
a nip is a small measure of spirits
e.g. (for example) is what 'say' means when introducing an instance

explanation.surface: After a win, someone suggests a modest celebratory tipple.
explanation.definitionFit: Winnipeg is the provincial capital of Manitoba in Canada, so it is an example of a capital city.

clue.text: In charge, undermining club? That's somehow incongruous

indicators.note: undermining places the abbreviation below the club in this down entry

parts.note: an iron is a golf club

explanation.surface: A boss sabotaging a club seems out of place.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironic describes a situation whose outcome is oddly at odds with expectation, a kind of incongruity.

clue.text: Half-heartedly try to persuade member of the upper house?

indicators.note: half-heartedly drops one of the two central letters of the word for persuade

parts.note: to nobble is to try to influence someone improperly

explanation.surface: A lukewarm attempt to lobby a peer.
explanation.walkthrough: NOBBLE has a double B at its heart; losing one is half its heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Peers sitting in the House of Lords, the UK upper chamber, are nobility.

clue.text: Praise gay prince for coming out

indicators.note: coming out says the letters of gay prince emerge in a new order

explanation.surface: Plaudits for a royal who has publicly come out as gay.
explanation.definitionFit: A panegyric is a speech or text of lavish public eulogy, so it is a noun meaning praise.

clue.text: Modern music fills Georgia with feeling of unease

indicators.note: fills means the feeling goes inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: GA is the US state abbreviation for Georgia
angst is anxiety

explanation.surface: New music leaves the state of Georgia uneasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Gangsta rap is a genre of hip-hop from the late twentieth century, recent music.

clue.text: Thus useless person without love becomes pompous

parts.note: thus means so

indicators.note: without tells us the letter for love is taken out of the useless person

parts.note: a lemon is a dud, a useless person or thing
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A hopeless person, once loveless, turns self-important.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes O from LEMON, leaving LEMN.
explanation.definitionFit: Solemn can mean portentously grave or self-important, close in sense to pompous.

clue.text: Salvationists with little time on a group of islands

parts.note: SA is the Salvation Army
a mo is a moment, a short time

explanation.surface: Salvation Army members briefly visit a Pacific archipelago.
explanation.definitionFit: Samoa is a Pacific nation made up of several islands, an example of an archipelago.

clue.text: Seafood disgustingly gelatinous I rejected

indicators.note: disgustingly means the letters of the clue word for jelly-like are mixed up

parts.note: the I is the letter rejected from the mix

explanation.surface: I refused the seafood because it was revoltingly jelly-like.
explanation.walkthrough: Take I out of GELATINOUS ('rejected') and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A langouste is a spiny lobster, an example of shellfish eaten as seafood.

clue.text: Significant chum with money in Oman

parts.note: a mate is a chum
the rial is the currency of Oman

explanation.surface: A rich friend who has his money in Oman.
explanation.definitionFit: Material, in legal use, means relevant and important, a synonym of significant.

clue.text: Sweet, turning more than one head

indicators.note: more than one head asks for the reversed word to appear twice
turning means the slang word for head is read backwards

parts.note: nob is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A sweet so good it turns several heads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes BON from NOB; 'more than one' doubles it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonbon is a small confection, a type of sweet.

clue.text: Put up comment about threatening Conservative being deposed

indicators.note: about means the comment goes around the remaining letters

parts.note: a note is a brief comment

indicators.note: being deposed says the Conservative is removed from the word for threatening

parts.note: minatory is a formal word for threatening
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A remark about a menacing Tory who is being thrown out of office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conservative' looks like a candidate being nominated; it is TORY, deleted ('being deposed') from a rare formal word for threatening, with 'about' wrapping the comment round what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: To put up a candidate is to propose them for election, a synonym.

clue.text: Differs from rich man, having to grab bit of work

indicators.note: having to grab means the rich man holds the unit of work inside

parts.note: Dives is the traditional name of the rich man in the parable of Lazarus
an erg is a small unit of work in physics

explanation.surface: Someone is unlike a wealthy man who must snatch at any job.
explanation.definitionFit: When paths or opinions diverge they go separate ways, so the word is a synonym of differs.

clue.text: A table like the captain's?

parts.note: a board is a table, as in 'bed and board'

explanation.surface: Is this table of the sort found in the captain's cabin?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a playful definition: a captain is on board his ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Like the captain, someone on the ship is on board, so the word describes his position.

clue.text: Tsar? One looked up to, though sometimes lacking in brightness

definitions.text: One looked up to, though sometimes lacking in brightness

parts.note: the letters of the word tsar are those of star rearranged, so the clue word is a variable arrangement of star

explanation.surface: A tsar is revered, though not always a bright spark.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as wordplay: VARIABLE (rearranged) STAR gives the clue's TSAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronomers call a star whose brightness fluctuates this, and stars are things gazed up at in the sky.

clue.text: Device lit when working, that is to say

indicators.note: when working means the letters of device lit are put into operation in another order

explanation.surface: A gadget lights up when switched on, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: Videlicet, Latin and shortened to viz., introduces a clarification, namely.

clue.text: Members keeping within group of top people? They know the rules

indicators.note: keeping within means the limbs hold the elite group inside

parts.note: legs are limbs, members of the body
the A-list is the group of top celebrities

explanation.surface: Members keeping to an elite circle know the rulebook.
explanation.definitionFit: Legalists insist on strict adherence to law, so they are sticklers who know regulations.

clue.text: Desert traveller in vehicle admitting state of confusion

indicators.note: admitting means the vehicle lets the confusion in

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a melee is a confused scrum or brawl

explanation.surface: A desert traveller in a car finds himself in chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A cameleer drives or rides camels, a typical means of crossing deserts.

clue.text: One could age, troubled by minimal energy — keep this on dressing table?

indicators.note: troubled means the letters of the words one could age are stirred up

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for energy, and a single letter is a minimal amount

explanation.surface: An ageing person, short on energy, keeps things handy on the dressing table.
explanation.definitionFit: Cologne scent is a toiletry typically kept on a dressing table, an example of what goes there.

clue.text: One restrains learner having conceited boast with little hesitation

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate
I'm it is a conceited boast of being the best
er is a short hesitation

explanation.surface: A trainee whose big-headed boast comes out with a little stammer.
explanation.definitionFit: A limiter is a device or person that keeps something within bounds, so it restrains.

clue.text: Upset after agent shows something we've seen before?

indicators.note: after places the upset after the agent

parts.note: a rep is a sales agent
to eat someone, as in 'what's eating you?', is to upset them

explanation.surface: Upset after an agent displays something familiar.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeat is a rebroadcast of a TV show, something already watched.

clue.text: Authenticated script offering more than one field of study

definitions.text: more than one field of study

parts.note: something authenticated is real, genuine
MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a script

explanation.surface: A verified manuscript offers material for several fields of study.
explanation.definitionFit: Realms are domains or spheres, so the plural covers several fields of study.

clue.text: I am surprised, overcome by what is blue and sordid

indicators.note: overcome by puts the exclamation under the blue in this down entry

parts.note: the sea is blue
my! is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: Surprise at something blue and smutty.
explanation.definitionFit: Seamy means showing the unpleasant side, synonym of sordid.

clue.text: One managing particular shop or factory, unendingly lazy

parts.note: a mill is a factory

indicators.note: unendingly means the word for lazy loses its final letter

parts.note: inert means sluggish, lazy

explanation.surface: A manager of a shop or factory who never stops being idle.
explanation.definitionFit: A milliner makes and sells hats, so runs a particular kind of shop.

clue.text: Drive mile in one short shower

indicators.note: in means the mile sits within the other pieces

parts.note: I is the roman numeral one

indicators.note: short means the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: to pelt is to shower with missiles or rain

explanation.surface: Driving a mile in a brief downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: To impel is to drive forward, a synonym.

clue.text: What church composer could do, showing bias

definitions.meaning: a church composer might write a chant, read as two words: pen a chant

explanation.surface: A church composer's work reveals his musical leanings.
explanation.definitionFit: A penchant is a strong liking or inclination, which is a bias toward something.

clue.text: Like famous holy room used by Jesus finally for meal

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of Jesus

parts.note: the Upper Room is where the Last ... took place

explanation.surface: The famous Upper Room was where Jesus took a final meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Supper is an evening meal, a synonym.

clue.text: Bishop irritable, like a badly behaved youngster

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
ratty is informal British for irritable

explanation.surface: A grumpy bishop behaves like a naughty child.
explanation.definitionFit: Bratty describes the manner of a brat, a spoilt or unruly child.

clue.text: Unwavering English group of workers, one not winning after setback

indicators.note: after setback means the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: TU is a trade union
a loser is one who does not win

explanation.surface: An English trade union stays firm, even after a loser's setback.
explanation.definitionFit: Being resolute means being firmly determined, which is unwavering.
